answer: Price identity as a bond that grows with use. To speak, an agent locks 10 + 0.2n tokens, n = lifetime messages; the kernel drops any message whose lock is absent, so enforcement is automatic. The bond binds to the key's genesis proof - it cannot be reset, split, or pre-grown; a fresh wallet restarts at zero. Carry is priced: 5% annualized per horizon, so an honest user pays it once while n puppets each pay full price. A randomly drawn falcon auditor spot-checks timing proofs; failure forfeits the entire bond, making sybil cost grow linearly in n.
